wallet.title: E-wallet
wallet.unused: Withdraw unused funds even before posting a job. Funds committed to jobs, disputes, or withdrawals are unavailable.

wallet.detailsNotice: Review the recipient carefully. Reviewing these details does not verify ownership of the external account.
wallet.correct: I confirm that the amount and destination are correct.

status.requested: Withdrawal submitted. Waiting for Finance approval.

hireChecklist.title: Work checklist
hireChecklist.hint: Add up to 20 tasks, 500 characters each. Track completion after hiring in Job Management → View details.
hireChecklist.empty: Add at least one description or turn off the optional checklist.
hireChecklist.trackingOnly: Checklist marks are for employer tracking only. They do not affect job status, evidence submission, work completion, or payment.
hireChecklist.hireWarning: Cannot delete the job after confirming the hire.

lifecycle.dailyProofHint: Submit pictures for each work date. Proof is sent to the same job chat. Future work dates cannot be submitted.
lifecycle.noWorkDates: No unpaid work dates are available yet.
lifecycle.dailyPayConfirmation: Release PHP {{amount}} to the worker for {{date}} now? This pays only this day and keeps the job status unchanged.
lifecycle.terms: Before work starts, either party may cancel with a reason. After work starts, cancellation requires agreement on payment or Finance review. Unpaid submitted work receives reminders after 24 and 48 hours; nonpayment disputes are available after 72 hours.
lifecycle.releaseNotice: I confirm the recipient and amount and authorize release of secured funds.
lifecycle.acknowledge: I have reviewed and accept the cancellation terms.
lifecycle.releaseAmount: Release {{amount}} from secured job funds. No additional wallet debit is required.
lifecycle.respondNotice: The proposed worker payment is {{amount}}. Accept to settle the assignment, or request Finance review.
lifecycle.evidenceNotice: Both parties have seven days to provide evidence. Missing evidence does not automatically decide the case.
lifecycle.interviewRequired: Interview required before sending an offer
lifecycle.cancelPostingNotice: Recruitment will stop. Started assignments need agreement or Finance review; funds remain held until resolved.
lifecycle.offerCancelNotice: Cancel this offer and release its reserved position where recruitment is open. Additional negotiated funds return to the employer wallet; base job funding remains secured for a replacement.
lifecycle.repostNotice: Create a new posting and secure the displayed funds from my wallet. Existing history will be preserved.
lifecycle.closeRecruitmentNotice: Stop new applications and offers? Existing hired assignments will continue. If all hired workers are already paid and no offers remain, the job will be completed and unused secured funds returned.
lifecycle.reopenRecruitmentNotice: Reopen recruitment for remaining funded slots? Existing hired assignments will continue.
lifecycle.completionImagesHint: Choose 1–5 JPG or PNG images, up to 5 MB each.
lifecycle.proofAllowedTypes: Allowed: JPG/JPEG and PNG images only
lifecycle.proofBlockedTypesHint: HEIC/HEIF, BMP, SVG, and TIFF images cannot be uploaded because they are not supported image types. PDFs, Word documents, spreadsheets, videos, audio, ZIP files, and all other formats are also not accepted. A text-only submission is not accepted.
lifecycle.proofInvalidImageType: "{{name}}" cannot be uploaded because it is not a supported image type. Only JPG/JPEG and PNG images are allowed. HEIC/HEIF, BMP, SVG, TIFF, and other file types are not accepted.
lifecycle.completeJobConfirmation: Mark the job as completed? This will release the funds to the worker.
lifecycle.jobCompleted: Job completed. Funds released to the worker.
lifecycle.completionStatement: Describe the completed work and supporting proof
lifecycle.completionFile: Attach a photo or document (optional, up to 5 MB)
lifecycle.evidenceTooLarge: The evidence file must be 5 MB or smaller.
lifecycle.signInRequired: Sign in to submit completion evidence.
lifecycle.downloadOnAndroid: Use the Android app or web application to download evidence.
lifecycle.downloadFailed: Unable to download the evidence file.
lifecycle.evidenceSaved: Evidence saved to your selected folder.
